narr: Two people were killed after heavy rain which produced a destructive debris flow in the Cameron Peak burn area. The 37-yr old woman and her 12-yr old daughter were in a camp trailer that was swept away at Calcite Road along Sheep Creek. In addition, a cabin along Granite Road was destroyed in the flood. Buckhorn Rd (LCR 44H) was heavily damaged in the flood. Several other roads were washed out or extensively damaged.
ev: Two people were killed when very heavy rainfall produced flash flooding in the Cameron Peak burn area.
